items.summary: In QuizScreen.tsx, fix the correct answer option so that after the user clicks and the answer is revealed, the text label of the correct option is displayed in a clearly visible, high-contrast font color (e.g., dark text such as deep teal or dark green, not white-on-white or invisible) and is rendered in bold. The image shows that option B is highlighted with a teal/green background and border but the option text is invisible — this must be corrected so the text is legible against the highlighted background. Apply the same fix to ReviewScreen.tsx wherever the correct answer option is highlighted.
